offloadRoot.description: Absolute path, or path relative to $DSH_HOME. Default: offload (= $DSH_HOME/offload).

inlineMaxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte cap for model-facing plain-text tool results. Over → write full output to offload file + head/tail preview.

offloadReadMaxInlineBytes.description: When read targets a path under offloadRoot: allow this much inline; above → in-place truncate (no second offload file).

ageMaskEnabled.description: DEPRECATED no-op. Accepted only so existing profiles keep loading. On dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.2.x the agent/pre-step hook never sees the full history, so no tool result is ever masked; use contextClear instead.

ageMaskKeepRecentN.description: DEPRECATED no-op. Accepted only for backward compatibility with ageMaskEnabled; ignored. Use contextClear.keepRecentResults.

contextClear.description: Compaction-coupled clearing of old tool results (opt-in; default off). Only acts in the pre-step right after compaction-basic summarises, clearing old tool results kept in the retained tail via a persistent surfaceOp replace. acp / acp-lite leave this unconfigured => disabled. Implementation lands in T2/T3.

enabled.description: Master switch. false (default) = never clear anything.

mode.description: Only 'compaction-coupled' has an effect; 'off' is equivalent to enabled:false.

keepRecentResults.description: Newest N tool results in the compaction-retained tail kept in full; older ones may be cleared.

minResultBytes.description: Results smaller than this many UTF-8 bytes are left untouched.

placeholder.description: Head/tail byte budgets for the placeholder left in place of a cleared result.

collapseWriteSteps.description: Also collapse oversized write/edit step arguments in the retained tail.

excludeTools.description: Tool names that skip eager offload entirely.

toolOverrides.description: Per-tool inlineMaxBytes overrides (e.g. tighter for bash).
